shadowSentences: I enjoy reading books every night.
Listening to music helps me relax.
My favorite hobby is painting landscapes.
Traveling opens up new perspectives on life.
Cooking new recipes is both fun and rewarding.
I like to go jogging in the early morning.
Spending time with friends improves my mood.
Volunteering at the local shelter is very fulfilling.
Learning a new language can be challenging but exciting.
Gardening teaches patience and gives a sense of accomplishment.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel experiences.
questions: Q1: Can you share a memorable travel experience you had?
Q2: What challenges did you face during this trip?
Q3: How do you feel travel impacts personal growth?
Q4: What advice would you give someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to participate in a study about sports and exercise habits.
questions: Q1: What type of sports do you enjoy playing?
Q2: Have you ever faced any obstacles in maintaining your fitness?
Q3: In your opinion, why is regular exercise important?
Q4: What tips would you give to someone starting a workout routine?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about environmental awareness.
questions: Q1: Can you describe a time when you helped the environment?
Q2: What difficulties do people face when trying to be eco-friendly?
Q3: What is your view on the current state of environmental issues?
Q4: How can individuals make a positive impact on the environment?
